page.overview:
Who is Óscar González?

Óscar González (born 10 November 1923 and died 5 November 2006) was an Uruguayan driver who competed in the 1956 Argentine Grand Prix with fellow Uruguayan driver Alberto Uria in a privateer . Uria and González both raced half the race distance and finished in 6th position.
